component.name: NSSF Digital Statement Dispatcher
component.summary: Validate, password-protect, and securely dispatch NSSF member statements

description.p: NSSF Digital Statement Dispatcher is the official desktop portal for validating, encrypting, and securely dispatching member statements via Email (SMTP) and WhatsApp for the National Social Security Fund (NSSF) Kenya.
All member documents are processed locally on the workstation with full audit logging and per-member PDF password protection.
